title: Motion-Picture Film (8-mm Type S) - 50-Ft Model 1 Sound Camera Cartridge - Pressure Pad Flatness and Camera Aperture Profile
scope: This standard specifies the dimensions and characteristics necessary for the appropriate flatness of the cartridge pressure pads as well as the required clearances for the film in the aperture area in 8-mm type S 50ft model 1 sound motion-picture film camera cartridges.
